name: Lodestar GLPOracle donatable plvGLP exchange rate
summary: Lodestar's GLPOracle.getPlutusExchangeRate() prices plvGLP as plvGLP.totalAssets() * 1e18 / plvGLP.totalSupply(), an instantaneous read of an ERC-4626 vault whose totalAssets() is the vault's plsGLP balance. Any transfer of plsGLP into the vault raises the numerator without minting shares, and getPlvGLPPrice() multiplies that ratio by the GLP price with no moving average, deviation bound, or same-block change guard. Within one transaction the attacker donated 5,620,813.918834889782579953 plsGLP into the vault, lifting the rate from 1.079668824382448539 to 1.822433552033092528, and PriceOracleProxyETH.getUnderlyingPrice(lplvGLP) relayed the inflated price to the Compound-fork Comptroller, letting a looped plvGLP position borrow out every other Lodestar market.

loss.notes: Components are the exact net underlying depletion of Lodestar's Compound-fork markets, summed from the Transfer logs of the four campaign transactions (the anchor plus 0xa9a12d1f, 0xb91ef85f and 0x752547f7, which took the lMAGIC and lDPX markets). Attacker deposits are already netted: in the anchor the lUSDC market pays out 71,775,069.474207 USDC.e against 70,096,512.99552 supplied back by the attacker, and the lplvGLP market pays out 64,845,499.745667204 plvGLP against 61,031,058.58415737 supplied back, leaving the 1,678,556.478687 USDC.e and 3,814,441.161509835687601554 plvGLP recorded here. Every market except lLODE was left at exactly its 10-unit seed dust. Native ETH is the lETH market's balance change from 124.693719452169514630 to 0.1. plvGLP has no DefiLlama observation; it is valued at 0.917512181012688097 USD, the value Lodestar's own GLPOracle.getPlvGLPPrice() returned at block 45121903, i.e. before the donation inflated the rate to 1.548720260621492204. All other assets use DefiLlama historical prices at the anchor timestamp. PlutusDAO later returned about 2.72 million GLP that the attacker had stranded in the plvGLP vault, and 750,000 LODE was distributed to affected wallets; per methodology those recoveries do not reduce gross depletion. Reported figures range from 5.8 to 7 million USD, with CertiK giving about 6.5 million attacker profit and DefiLlama 6.9 million; the reconstruction here is larger mainly because it counts the plvGLP at pre-attack net asset value and includes the later lMAGIC and lDPX drains.

ageReset.description: GLPOracle is a plain non-proxy contract with no DELEGATECALL in its runtime. Its runtime is byte-identical at the creation block, at the block before the exploit, and today, so the executed pricing code dates from deployment four days and 14 hours earlier.

sources.note: Reviewed the anchor receipt (334 logs) and its 8,882-frame callTracer trace, the verified GLPOracle and PriceOracleProxyETH sources, historical runtime hashes and archive eth_calls, the eleven Comptroller markets' balances before and after, and the three follow-up campaign receipts. The anchor is status 1 at block 45121904 index 1, timestamp 1670690606. In the trace, PriceOracleProxyETH 0x5947189d2d7765e4f629c803581ffd06bc57de9b (getUnderlyingPrice, 0xfc57d4df, 96 frames) STATICCALLs GLPOracle 0xba46f854a5b099fcea178c6e7ed047baffece5ac getPlvGLPPrice (0x731cf425) 42 times, and the oracle reads plvGLP 0x5326e71ff593ecc2cf7acae5fe57582d6e74cff1 totalAssets (0x01e1d114) and totalSupply (0x18160ddd) 42 times each; glpOracleAddress on the proxy resolves to 0xba46f854 at block 45121903. Boundary test: GLPOracle exposes no pricing parameters at all - only admin, GLP, GLPManager and plvGLP address setters - so there is no parameter value at which the deployed formula is correct; Lodestar's own post-mortem says the oracle design needed to be completely rethought, and the fix shipped as new code, PlvGLPOracle 0x5ba0828a5488c20a9c6521a90ecc9c49e5390604 with HistoricalIndices, a windowSize moving average and a MAX_SWING bound, deployed 2023-03-15 for a new Comptroller; the old oracle was never replaced in place (zero newGlpOracle events). GLPOracle was created by top-level CREATE from 0x67e57a0ec37768eaf99a364975ec4e1f98920d01 in 0x01612ff4a259f54c44e08778beb0ea28312d0b6ac956b3a61a52858656dc2d49 at block 43961659 index 1; no code exists at 43961658 and its runtime hashes to 0x29302c69c519e8bbba1a860091b70944d839f5564d1323cd1e91ffb50e3a5981 at the creation block, at block 45121903 and at head, so codeAgeSeconds is 1670690606 - 1670294017 = 396589 (4.59 days). getPlutusExchangeRate() returns 1079668824382448539 at block 45121903 and 1822433552033092528 at 45121904; getPlvGLPPrice() returns 917512181012688097 and 1548720260621492204 respectively; the rate is flat at about 1.0788-1.0797 from block 44684000 onward, so no earlier transaction in the attacker's day-long rehearsal series had donated. Market underlying balances fall to their 10-unit seeds: lUSDC 1678566.478687 to 10, lDAI 407129.894855655961773024 to 10, lUSDT 397850.679709 to 10, lFRAX 361336.024023817648655341 to 10, lMIM 204670.267753251313632099 to 10, lWBTC 12.52088803 to 0.001, lETH 124.693719452169514630 to 0.1, lplvGLP 3814451.161509835687601554 to 10, and in the later campaign transactions lMAGIC 244397.328847152656440708 to 0.1 and lDPX 414.620343767192446310 to 0.1. Campaign transfer sums attribute 280632.870029536866929986 MAGIC and 273.368900733130736421 DPX to the attacker; the remaining lDPX movement in the window is not attributable to a campaign transaction and is excluded. The seed row measured the lplvGLP CErc20Delegator at 18.9 days; the defect-bearing artifact is the immutable GLPOracle, which is why this record's age is 4.59 days.

limitations: plvGLP has no third-party historical price. Its 3,814,441.161509835687601554 units are valued at 0.917512181012688097 USD, the pre-donation output of Lodestar's own GLPOracle at block 45121903. plvGLP is a vault share with thin secondary liquidity and a redemption fee, so this is a net-asset-value mark rather than an executable price; it is 49 percent of the incident total.

The lDPX market lost 414.520343767192446310 DPX between block 45121903 and block 45129430 but only 273.368900733130736421 of that is attributable to a transaction of this campaign; the unattributed remainder is excluded.
